titleEn: Do You Need an Electrician During a Home Renovation in Vancouver?
titleZh: 温哥华装修需要电工吗？何时必须聘请持牌电工
contentEn:
Under British Columbia's Electrical Safety Regulation, any work that modifies, extends or moves electrical circuits must be performed by a qualified person. For homeowners in Vancouver and the Lower Mainland, this means a licensed electrical contractor. Reno Stars, a full-service renovation company serving Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam and Vancouver, includes licensed electricians on every project that involves wiring changes.

The short answer is yes — you almost always need an electrician during a renovation. The longer answer depends on what you are doing. Adding recessed lighting, moving a kitchen island, installing a new bathroom circuit or upgrading an electrical panel all require permits and inspections. A homeowner who does this work themselves risks failing a required inspection, voiding home insurance coverage and creating safety hazards.

What requires a licensed electrician in a BC renovation?

Any of the following jobs legally require a licensed electrician in British Columbia:

  • Adding, moving or extending electrical circuits
  • Installing or replacing an electrical panel or sub-panel
  • Running wire through walls during a renovation
  • Installing recessed (can) lighting
  • Adding kitchen appliance circuits (stove, oven, dishwasher)
  • Installing bathroom exhaust fan circuits
  • Upgrading to 200-amp service

Surface-mounted LED fixture swaps — swapping a light fixture for a similar model — do not require a permit. Anything that involves opening a circuit or running new wire does. Reno Stars pulls the required permits and books BC Safety Authority inspections as part of every project that involves electrical work.

When can a homeowner do electrical work in BC?

BC's Homeowner Protection Act allows owners to perform limited electrical work on their own principal residence. The work must be inspected, and the owner must pass an electrical competency exam for the scope of work being done. In practice, most homeowners hire a licensed contractor because the inspection process and liability exposure make DIY electrical work expensive and risky.

Reno Stars works exclusively with licensed electricians registered with Technical Safety BC. Every electrical component installed during a renovation is inspected and certified before the project is closed.

How does electrical work fit into a renovation timeline?

Electrical rough-in is completed during the framing and insulation stage, before drywall is closed. This means the electrician must be on-site early — typically during weeks two to four of a whole-home renovation. Reno Stars coordinates all trades in advance so the electrical sequence is ready when needed.

The sequence looks like this:

  • Demo and framing complete
  • Electrical rough-in (wiring, boxes, panel upgrades)
  • Electrical inspection (BC Safety Authority)
  • Insulation and vapour barrier
  • Drywall close
  • Electrical finish work (fixtures, switches, plates)
  • Final electrical inspection

How much does electrical work add to a renovation cost in Vancouver?

Based on typical whole-home renovations in the Vancouver area completed by Reno Stars, electrical work represents 8 to 15 percent of the total project budget when panel upgrades are included. A new 200-amp panel upgrade alone runs $2,500 to $5,000 depending on the utility connection. Recessed lighting adds $150 to $350 per fixture installed, including the pot light housing, wiring and trim.

Reno Stars provides a full line-item estimate during the design phase so there are no surprises mid-project.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does a bathroom renovation need an electrician in BC?

Yes. Adding a new vanity light circuit, exhaust fan, heater or any hardwired fixture in a bathroom requires a licensed electrician and a permit. This work must pass a BC Safety Authority inspection before the bathroom can be considered complete.

Can I do my own electrical work during a renovation in British Columbia?

You can perform limited electrical work on your principal residence if you pass the required Technical Safety BC exams and schedule the inspection. Most homeowners find it more cost-effective to hire a licensed contractor who handles the permit, inspection and liability as part of the renovation.

How long does electrical rough-in take during a renovation?

Electrical rough-in for a whole-home renovation typically takes two to four days on-site, depending on the complexity of the wiring plan. Reno Stars schedules all rough-in work before insulation so there are no delays to the project timeline.

Does a kitchen island need an electrician?

Any kitchen island that includes a cooktop, wine fridge, built-in microwave or pop-out outlets requires a dedicated circuit run by a licensed electrician. Even cosmetic electrical additions like under-cabinet lighting need to be wired to code.

根据卑诗省电气安全条例，任何修改、扩展或移动电路的工程必须由合资格人员操作。在温哥华及低陆平原地区，这意味着需要聘请持牌电工。聚星装修（ Reno Stars ）是一家全方位装修公司，服务列治文、本拿比、科莫克斯和温哥华，所有涉及布线更改的工程项目均配备持牌电工。

简短的回答是：几乎所有装修项目都需要电工。更长的答案取决于具体工程内容。新增嵌入式照明、移动厨房岛台、安装新浴室电路或升级配电箱，均需要许可证和检查。如果业主自行施工，可能无法通过要求检查、导致房屋保险失效，并造成安全隐患。

卑诗省装修中哪些工作必须由持牌电工完成？

以下任何工程在卑诗省均必须由持牌电工完成：

  • 新增、移动或扩展电路
  • 安装或更换配电箱或子配电箱
  • 在装修期间穿墙布线
  • 安装嵌入式（筒）灯
  • 新增厨房电器电路（炉具、烤箱、洗碗机）
  • 安装浴室排气扇电路
  • 升级至200安培服务

表面安装的LED灯具更换——更换类似型号的灯具——无需许可证。但任何涉及打开电路或铺设新线路的工作均需要许可证。聚星装修在所有涉及电气工程的项目中代为申请许可证并安排卑诗省安全管理局检查。

业主在卑诗省何时可以自行做电气工作？

卑诗省《业主保护法》允许业主在其主要住宅进行有限的电气工程。工程必须接受检查，业主还须就所从事的工程范围通过电气能力考试。实际上，大多数业主会选择聘请持牌承包商，因为检查流程和责任风险使DIY电气工作成本高、风险大。

聚星装修只与在Technical Safety BC注册的持牌电工合作。每个在装修期间安装的电气元件均会在项目竣工前接受检查并获得认证。

电气工作如何融入装修时间表？

电气粗装阶段在框架和保温层施工期间完成，具体是在干墙封闭之前。这意味着电工必须提前进场——通常在整个房屋装修的第二至四周内。聚星装修提前协调所有相关工种，确保电气工序在需要时已准备就绪。

整个工序流程如下：

  • 拆除和框架施工完成
  • 电气粗装（布线、线盒、配电箱升级）
  • 电气检查（卑诗省安全管理局）
  • 保温层和防潮层
  • 干墙封闭
  • 电气收尾工程（灯具、开关、面板）
  • 最终电气检查

温哥华装修中电气工程会增加多少成本？

根据聚星装修在温哥华地区完成的典型整体房屋装修数据，电气工程占项目总预算的8%至15%（含配电箱升级）。仅新增200安培配电箱升级费用就在$2,500至$5,000之间，具体取决于电力连接方式。嵌入式照明每个灯具含安装费用为$150至$350，包括筒灯外壳、布线和装饰圈。

聚星装修在设计阶段提供完整逐项报价，确保项目中途不会出现意外费用。

计划进行厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？立即联系聚星装修，获取免费、无义务报价。

常见问题

卑诗省浴室装修需要电工吗？

需要。新增浴室洗手台灯电路、排气扇、加热器或任何硬接线装置均需要持牌电工和许可证。这项工作必须通过卑诗省安全管理局检查，浴室才能视为完工。

在卑诗省装修期间我可以自行做电气工程吗？

如果您通过了Technical Safety BC的相关考试并安排了检查，您可以就在主要住宅进行有限的电气工程。实际上，大多数业主发现聘请持牌承包商更划算，因为承包商会处理许可证、检查和责任问题，作为装修的一部分。

装修期间电气粗装需要多长时间？

全屋装修的电气粗装通常需要两到四天，具体取决于布线计划的复杂程度。聚星装修会在保温层施工前安排所有粗装工程，确保不会延误项目工期。

厨房岛台需要电工吗？

任何包含电磁炉、酒柜、内置微波炉或弹出式插座的厨房岛台，均需要由持牌电工铺设专用电路。即使是装饰性的电气新增项目（如橱柜底灯），也需要按照规范布线。
